description: This file defines the Tooltip class for Bootstrap v3.3.7, implementing tooltip UI components with initialization, positioning, event handling, and rendering logic.

classes.name: Tooltip
classes.description: Class managing tooltip behavior including show, hide, position, and event handling.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes tooltip with type, element, and options.

methods.name: getDefaults
methods.description: Returns default options for tooltip.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Merges user options with defaults.

methods.name: getDelegateOptions
methods.description: Returns options for delegated tooltip.

methods.name: enter
methods.description: Handles mouseenter or focusin events to show tooltip.

methods.name: leave
methods.description: Handles mouseleave or focusout events to hide tooltip.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the tooltip with positioning and transition.

methods.name: applyPlacement
methods.description: Positions the tooltip element based on calculated offsets.

methods.name: replaceArrow
methods.description: Adjusts the position of the tooltip arrow.

methods.name: setContent
methods.description: Sets the tooltip content based on title.

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Hides the tooltip with transition.

methods.name: fixTitle
methods.description: Removes the title attribute to prevent default browser tooltips.

methods.name: hasContent
methods.description: Checks if tooltip has content.

methods.name: getPosition
methods.description: Calculates position of element for placement.

methods.name: getCalculatedOffset
methods.description: Calculates tooltip offset based on placement.

methods.name: getViewportAdjustedDelta
methods.description: Adjusts tooltip position to stay within viewport.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Retrieves tooltip title from element or options.

methods.name: getUID
methods.description: Generates unique ID for tooltip.

methods.name: tip
methods.description: Returns or creates tooltip DOM element.

methods.name: arrow
methods.description: Returns tooltip arrow element.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables tooltip.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables tooltip.

methods.name: toggleEnabled
methods.description: Toggles tooltip enabled state.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles tooltip visibility.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys tooltip instance and cleans up.
